$comment: Single source of the literature references (RefKey). Edit here, then run `make references-generate`; it rewrites backend/src/common/thermal/enum/ref-key.enum.ts, backend/src/common/thermal/dto/ref-key.dto.ts, python/src/references/ref_key.py, python/src/references/references_meta.py and the table in docs/REFERENCES.md. Never rename, renumber or remove an entry; append new ones with the next index.

references.name: Szargut — Termodynamika Techniczna
references.citation: Szargut, J. — *Termodynamika Techniczna* (Technical Thermodynamics). Wyd. Politechniki Śląskiej, multiple editions. Standard Cp polynomials (linearHyperbolic form: a + bT + d/T²).

references.name: Incropera et al. — Fundamentals of Heat and Mass Transfer 6th ed.
references.citation: Incropera, F.P.; DeWitt, D.P.; Bergman, T.L.; Lavine, A.S. — *Fundamentals of Heat and Mass Transfer*, 6th ed. Wiley, 2007. Thermal conductivity and viscosity tables/correlations. URL: https://booksite.elsevier.com/9780750683661/Appendix_C.pdf

references.name: Hilsenrath et al. — NBS Tables of Thermal Properties of Gases
references.citation: Hilsenrath, J. et al. — *Tables of Thermal Properties of Gases*. NBS Circular 564, 1955. URL: https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/GOVPUB-C13-89baf9f9b4a43e5f25820bd51b0f3f11/pdf/GOVPUB-C13-89baf9f9b4a43e5f25820bd51b0f3f11.pdf

references.name: Perry's Chemical Engineers' Handbook 7th ed.
references.citation: Perry, R.H.; Green, D.W. (eds.) — *Perry's Chemical Engineers' Handbook*, 7th ed. McGraw-Hill, 1997. Aly–Lee Cp coefficients (Table 2-150) and polynomial Cp data.

references.name: Borgnakke & Sonntag — Thermodynamic and Transport Properties
references.citation: Borgnakke, C.; Sonntag, R.E. — *Thermodynamic and Transport Properties*. Wiley, 1997. URL: https://engineering.wayne.edu/mechanical/pdfs/thermodynamic-_tables-updated.pdf

references.name: Yaws — Chemical Properties Handbook
references.citation: Yaws, C.L. — *Chemical Properties Handbook: Physical, Thermodynamic, Environmental, Transport, Safety, and Health Related Properties for Organic and Inorganic Chemicals*. McGraw-Hill, 1999.

references.name: Poling, Prausnitz, O'Connell — The Properties of Gases and Liquids 5th ed.
references.citation: Poling, B.E.; Prausnitz, J.M.; O'Connell, J.P. — *The Properties of Gases and Liquids*, **5th ed.** McGraw-Hill, 2000. Ideal-gas Cp databank; Lennard-Jones σ and ε/k from viscosity data (Appendix B).

references.name: McBride, Zehe, Gordon — NASA TM-2002-211556
references.citation: McBride, B.J.; Zehe, M.J.; Gordon, S. — *NASA Glenn Coefficients for Calculating Thermodynamic Properties of Individual Species*. NASA TM-2002-211556, 2002. NASA-7 polynomial coefficients.

references.name: Burcat & Ruscic — ANL-05/20
references.citation: Burcat, A.; Ruscic, B. — *Third Millennium Ideal Gas and Condensed Phase Thermochemical Database for Combustion with Updates from Active Thermochemical Tables*. ANL-05/20, 2005.

references.name: Lemmon & Jacobsen — Viscosity and Thermal Conductivity for N2, O2, Ar, Air
references.citation: Lemmon, E.W.; Jacobsen, R.T. — *Viscosity and Thermal Conductivity Equations for Nitrogen, Oxygen, Argon, and Air*. International Journal of Thermophysics, 25(1), 2004. URL: https://trc.nist.gov/refprop/FAQ/NAO.PDF

references.name: Barreiros et al. — Thermal conductivity of gases
references.citation: Barreiros, A. et al. — *Thermal conductivity of gases at atmospheric pressure*. Phys. Chem. Res., 2019. URL: https://www.physchemres.org/article_57774_2e932c91424b9180df6a5d3b309c8720.pdf

references.name: Jones, Mason, Williams — Radiant emissivity
references.citation: Jones, J.M.; Mason, P.E.; Williams, A. — *A compilation of data on the radiant emissivity of some materials at high temperatures*. Journal of the Energy Institute, 92(3), pp. 523–534, 2019. ISSN 1743-9671. URL: https://eprints.whiterose.ac.uk/133266/7/emissivity%20manuscript%20revision%20%28final%29.pdf

references.name: Шейндлин А.Е. (ed.) — Излучательные свойства твёрдых материалов. Справочник, Энергия
references.citation: Шейндлин А.Е. (ed.) — *Излучательные свойства твёрдых материалов. Справочник* (Emissive Properties of Solid Materials. Handbook). Energiya, Moscow, 1974.

references.name: Bentz & Prasad — Thermal Performance of Fire Resistive Materials
references.citation: Bentz, D.P.; Prasad, K. — *Thermal Performance of Fire Resistive Materials I. Characterization with Respect to Thermal Performance Models*. NISTIR 7401, 2007. URL: https://www.researchgate.net/publication/241211063

references.name: NIST Cryogenic Materials Properties Database
references.citation: NIST Cryogenic Materials Properties Database. URL: https://trc.nist.gov/cryogenics/materials

references.name: Perry's Chemical Engineers' Handbook 9th ed.
references.citation: Perry, R.H.; Green, D.W. (eds.) — *Perry's Chemical Engineers' Handbook*, 9th ed. McGraw-Hill, 2019. DIPPR transport correlations (Eq. 102); Table 2-95 (pp. 2-167–2-173) ideal-gas ΔHf, ΔGf at 298.15 K (DIPPR 801, 2016).

references.name: DIPPR Fit Equations — Chemicals library documentation
references.citation: DIPPR Fit Equations documentation (Chemicals library). URL: https://chemicals.readthedocs.io/chemicals.dippr.html

references.name: WolframAlpha Online Integral Calculator
references.citation: WolframAlpha Online Integral Calculator — used to verify closed-form antiderivatives. URL: https://www.wolframalpha.com/calculators/integral-calculator/

references.name: Asano — Mass Transfer: From Fundamentals to Modern Industrial Applications
references.citation: Asano, K. — *Mass Transfer: From Fundamentals to Modern Industrial Applications*. Wiley-VCH, 2006. Lennard-Jones collision parameters (σ, ε/kB).

references.name: White — Viscous Fluid Flow 3rd ed.
references.citation: White, F.M. — *Viscous Fluid Flow*, 3rd ed. McGraw-Hill, 2006. Sutherland viscosity parameters (μ₀, T₀, S) in Appendix A. Power-law and Sutherland fits of viscosity and thermal conductivity (Tables 1-2, 1-3, A-6) and Lennard-Jones σ, ε/k (Table A-7) in `shared/sources/transport-parameters.json`.

references.name: Михеев М.А., Михеева И.М. — Основы теплопередачи, 2-е изд., Энергия
references.citation: Михеев М.А., Михеева И.М. — *Основы теплопередачи* (Fundamentals of Heat Transfer), 2nd ed. Энергия, 1977. Nu correlations for turbulent pipe flow (Mikheev equation); gas radiation heat transfer coefficients.

references.name: Whitaker S. — Forced Convection Heat Transfer Correlations for Flow in Pipes, Past Flat Plates, Single Cylinders, Single Spheres, and for Flow in Packed Beds and Tube Bundles, AIChE J. 18(2)
references.citation: Whitaker, S. — *Forced Convection Heat Transfer Correlations for Flow in Pipes, Past Flat Plates, Single Cylinders, Single Spheres, and for Flow in Packed Beds and Tube Bundles*. AIChE Journal, 18(2), pp. 361–371, 1972. Nu correlations for external and internal forced convection.

references.name: Burcat, A.; Ruscic, B. — Third Millennium Ideal Gas and Condensed Phase Thermochemical Database for Combustion with Updates from Active Thermochemical Tables, ANL-05/20. NASA-9 polynomial coefficients (with the McBride & Gordon NASA RP-1311 set).
references.citation: Burcat, A.; Ruscic, B. — *Third Millennium Ideal Gas and Condensed Phase Thermochemical Database for Combustion with Updates from Active Thermochemical Tables*. ANL-05/20, 2005. NASA-9 polynomial format coefficients for a wide range of species; the database (`backend/data/nasa/nasa9.json`) also contains the McBride, B.J.; Gordon, S. NASA RP-1311 (1996) set ("NASA RP-1311 set" in compound files). URL: https://publications.anl.gov/anlpubs/2005/07/53802.pdf

references.name: Caltech EDL — Shock and Detonation Toolbox: Thermodynamic Data
references.citation: California Institute of Technology Explosion Dynamics Laboratory — *Shock and Detonation Toolbox: Thermodynamic Data*. Caltech, maintained. Contains NASA-7 and NASA-9 coefficient databases. URL: https://shepherd.caltech.edu/EDL/PublicResources/sdt/thermo.html

references.name: Burcat, A.; Ruscic, B.; Goos, E. — Extended Third Millennium Thermodynamic Database (ELTE, updated)
references.citation: Burcat, A.; Ruscic, B.; Goos, E. — *Extended Third Millennium Thermodynamic Database of New NASA Polynomials with Active Thermochemical Tables update*. Hosted at ELTE (Eötvös Loránd University), updated continuously. URL: https://respecth.elte.hu/burcat.php

references.name: Basu, P. — Combustion and Gasification in Fluidized Beds, CRC Press
references.citation: Basu, P. — *Combustion and Gasification in Fluidized Beds*. CRC Press (Taylor & Francis), 2006, pp. 45–78. Solid fuel properties: `charcoal-briquette` preset (p. 67).

references.name: Van Krevelen, D.W. — Coal: Typology, Physics, Chemistry, Constitution, 3rd ed., Elsevier
references.citation: Van Krevelen, D.W. — *Coal: Typology – Physics – Chemistry – Constitution*, 3rd ed. Elsevier, 1993, pp. 220–250. Solid fuel properties: `charcoal-oak` preset (p. 235).

references.name: Laurendeau, N.M. — Heterogeneous Kinetics of Coal Char Gasification and Combustion, Prog. Energy Combust. Sci. 4(4)
references.citation: Laurendeau, N.M. — *Heterogeneous Kinetics of Coal Char Gasification and Combustion*. Progress in Energy and Combustion Science, 4(4), pp. 221–270, 1978. Char surface reaction kinetics (`BED_REACTIONS`).

references.name: Turns, S.R. — An Introduction to Combustion: Concepts and Applications, 3rd ed., McGraw-Hill
references.citation: Turns, S.R. — *An Introduction to Combustion: Concepts and Applications*, 3rd ed. McGraw-Hill, 2012, pp. 120–145. Gas-phase reaction kinetics (`BED_REACTIONS`).

references.name: Higman, C.; van der Burgt, M. — Gasification, 2nd ed., Gulf Professional Publishing
references.citation: Higman, C.; van der Burgt, M. — *Gasification*, 2nd ed. Gulf Professional Publishing (Elsevier), 2008, pp. 78–95. Boudouard and water-gas reactions (`BED_REACTIONS`).

references.name: Prohaska, T. et al. — Standard Atomic Weights of the Elements 2021 (IUPAC Technical Report), Pure Appl. Chem. 94(5)
references.citation: Prohaska, T. et al. — *Standard Atomic Weights of the Elements 2021 (IUPAC Technical Report)*. Pure and Applied Chemistry, 94(5), pp. 573–600, 2022. Conventional atomic weights (gas `Mr` values in `COMPOUND_LIBRARY`). URL: https://doi.org/10.1515/pac-2019-0603

references.name: Linstrom, P.J.; Mallard, W.G. (eds.) — NIST Chemistry WebBook, NIST Standard Reference Database 69
references.citation: Linstrom, P.J.; Mallard, W.G. (eds.) — *NIST Chemistry WebBook*, NIST Standard Reference Database Number 69. National Institute of Standards and Technology, maintained. Reference data for fits (NH3 Sutherland viscosity); Shomate Cp coefficients. URL: https://webbook.nist.gov/chemistry/

references.name: Ergun, S. — Fluid Flow through Packed Columns, Chem. Eng. Prog. 48(2)
references.citation: Ergun, S. — *Fluid Flow through Packed Columns*. Chemical Engineering Progress, 48(2), pp. 89–94, 1952. Packed-bed pressure drop (`AerodynamicsService`).

references.name: Green, D.W.; Perry, R.H. (eds.) — Perry's Chemical Engineers' Handbook 8th ed., McGraw-Hill
references.citation: Green, D.W.; Perry, R.H. (eds.) — *Perry's Chemical Engineers' Handbook*, 8th ed. McGraw-Hill, 2008. DIPPR Eq. 102 coefficients: Table 2-312 (vapor viscosity) and Table 2-314 (vapor thermal conductivity) for the fuel gases C2H6 … C3H6. Machine-readable copies of both tables: CalebBell/chemicals, `chemicals/Viscosity/Table 2-312 …tsv` and `chemicals/Thermal Conductivity/Table 2-314 …tsv`. Also Cp (Tables 2-151, 2-153) and liquid viscosity (Table 2-313). URL: https://github.com/CalebBell/chemicals

references.name: Eakin, B.E.; Ellington, R.T. — Predicting the Viscosity of Pure Light Hydrocarbons, J. Pet. Technol. 15(2), 210–214
references.citation: Eakin, B.E.; Ellington, R.T. — *Predicting the Viscosity of Pure Light Hydrocarbons*. Journal of Petroleum Technology, 15(2), pp. 210–214, 1963 (Trans. AIME 228). Table 1: Sutherland constants μ = B·T^1.5/(T + S) [μP, °R] for methane, ethane, propane, n-butane. URL: https://doi.org/10.2118/397-PA

references.name: Chase, M.W. Jr. — NIST-JANAF Thermochemical Tables, 4th ed., J. Phys. Chem. Ref. Data Monograph 9
references.citation: Chase, M.W. Jr. — *NIST-JANAF Thermochemical Tables*, 4th ed. Journal of Physical and Chemical Reference Data, Monograph 9, 1998 (NIST Standard Reference Database 13). Cp, S, H−H(298), ΔfH, ΔfG, log Kf and phase-transition temperatures of condensed and gaseous species; tables cited by ID (e.g. `O-045`). Machine-readable copy: py-janaf (n-takumasa), `src/janaf/data`, URL: https://github.com/n-takumasa/py-janaf. URL: https://janaf.nist.gov

references.name: Haynes, W.M.; Bruno, T.J.; Lide, D.R. (eds.) — CRC Handbook of Chemistry and Physics, 95th ed., CRC Press
references.citation: Haynes, W.M.; Bruno, T.J.; Lide, D.R. (eds.) — *CRC Handbook of Chemistry and Physics*, 95th ed. CRC Press, 2014. Melting and boiling points, densities, heats of fusion, ΔfH°, ΔfG°, S° and Cp at 298.15 K.

references.name: Yaws, C.L. — Thermophysical Properties of Chemicals and Hydrocarbons, 2nd ed., Gulf Professional Publishing
references.citation: Yaws, C.L. — *Thermophysical Properties of Chemicals and Hydrocarbons*, 2nd ed. Gulf Professional Publishing, 2014. Critical constants, acentric factors, boiling points, gas ΔfH° and S°.

references.name: Zabransky, M.; Ruzicka, V. Jr.; Majer, V.; Domalski, E.S. — Heat Capacity of Liquids: Critical Review and Recommended Values, J. Phys. Chem. Ref. Data Monograph 6
references.citation: Zabransky, M.; Ruzicka, V. Jr.; Majer, V.; Domalski, E.S. — *Heat Capacity of Liquids: Critical Review and Recommended Values*. J. Phys. Chem. Ref. Data Monograph 6, 1996. Liquid Cp correlations.

references.name: Thermodynamics Research Center — Thermodynamics of Organic Compounds in the Gas State, Vol. II, TRC
references.citation: Thermodynamics Research Center — *Thermodynamics of Organic Compounds in the Gas State*, Vol. II. TRC, 1994. Ideal-gas Cp coefficients.

references.name: VDI e.V. (ed.) — VDI Heat Atlas, 2nd ed., Springer
references.citation: VDI e.V. (ed.) — *VDI Heat Atlas*, 2nd ed. Springer, 2010. PPDS correlations: liquid and gas viscosity and thermal conductivity, liquid density, vapour pressure, enthalpy of vaporization, surface tension.

references.name: Magalhães, A.L.; Lito, P.F.; Da Silva, F.A.; Silva, C.M. — Simple and Accurate Correlations for Diffusion Coefficients of Solutes in Liquids and Supercritical Fluids, J. Supercrit. Fluids 76
references.citation: Magalhães, A.L.; Lito, P.F.; Da Silva, F.A.; Silva, C.M. — *Simple and Accurate Correlations for Diffusion Coefficients of Solutes in Liquids and Supercritical Fluids over Wide Ranges of Temperature and Density*. The Journal of Supercritical Fluids, 76, pp. 94–114, 2013. Lennard-Jones σ and ε/k of about 320 compounds (chemicals `MagalhaesLJ.tsv`). URL: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.supflu.2013.02.002

references.name: Svehla R.A. — Estimated Viscosities and Thermal Conductivities of Gases at High Temperatures, NASA TR R-132
references.citation: Svehla, R.A. — *Estimated Viscosities and Thermal Conductivities of Gases at High Temperatures*. NASA Technical Report R-132, 1962. Lennard-Jones σ and ε/k (via White, Viscous Fluid Flow, Table A-7; `shared/sources/transport-parameters.json`).

references.name: Itean E.C., Glueck A.R., Svehla R.A. — Collision Integrals for a Modified Stockmayer Potential, NASA TN D-481
references.citation: Itean, E.C.; Glueck, A.R.; Svehla, R.A. — *Collision Integrals for a Modified Stockmayer Potential*. NASA Technical Note D-481, Lewis Research Center, 1961. Stockmayer σ, ε/k, δ and dipole moments of polar molecules (Table III; `shared/sources/transport-parameters.json`).

references.name: Svehla R.A. — Transport Coefficients for the NASA Lewis Chemical Equilibrium Program, NASA TM-4647
references.citation: Svehla, R.A. — *Transport Coefficients for the NASA Lewis Chemical Equilibrium Program*. NASA Technical Memorandum 4647, 1995. Data sources of the CEA transport fits: potentials (Lennard-Jones, Stockmayer, Exp-6, corresponding states), modified Eucken Z, binary diffusion pairs (Table I; `shared/sources/transport-parameters.json`).

references.name: Mamedov B.A., Somuncu E. — Analytical treatment of second virial coefficient over Lennard-Jones (2n–n) potential, J. Mol. Struct. 1068
references.citation: Mamedov, B.A.; Somuncu, E. — *Analytical treatment of second virial coefficient over Lennard-Jones (2n–n) potential and its application to molecular systems*. Journal of Molecular Structure, 1068, pp. 164–169, 2014. Lennard-Jones σ and ε/k fitted to second virial coefficients (Table 1; `shared/sources/transport-parameters.json`).
